units.source_text: 看来对方有些丈二和尚摸不着头脑，纤弱的驼背向前弓得更加厉害了，可那表情依然很开朗。

en.t: It seemed the other person was rather at a loss, and the frail hunched back bent even farther forward, yet the expression remained cheerful.

units.source_text: 没有一点听得厌烦的样子。

en.t: There was not the slightest sign of being tired of listening.

units.source_text: 有人把他叫做“麦比乌斯圈”。

en.t: Some people called him the Mobius strip.

units.source_text: 所谓麦比乌斯圈，就是将一条纸带绞一下，

en.t: A so-called Mobius strip is made by giving a strip of paper a twist,

units.source_text: 然后将纸带背面的一端，粘在纸带表面的另一端，

en.t: then attaching one end of the back side of the strip to the other end of the front side,

units.source_text: 形成一个环，即一个不分表里的空间。

en.t: forming a loop, that is, a space with no distinction between inside and outside.

units.source_text: 也许说的是那男人将工会运动和自己的私生活如同麦比乌斯圈那样联系在一起了吧。

en.t: Perhaps it meant that the man had linked the union movement and his private life together like a Mobius strip.

units.source_text: 虽说有些讽刺的意味，但多少也带有些褒义。

en.t: Although it carried a somewhat ironic meaning, it also had a certain note of praise.
